host_os_family.title: Host operating-system family
host_os_family.description: The operating-system family of this host — the discriminator that selects which OS-specific hardening attestations apply. Linux exposes SELinux/AppArmor MAC and user-namespaces (Linux-only) plus sudo/setuid (any Unix); Windows exposes UAC/service-ACL and LSASS/Credential Guard; macOS/BSD use the Unix arm (sudo/setuid/credential-file perms) but not SELinux/AppArmor or user-namespaces. Cross-platform attestations (patch level, EOL, remote admin, boot integrity, disk encryption, IMDS) apply to every family. Gating on this field stops a Linux host being assessed against Windows controls and vice-versa.

host_patch_level_current.title: Host security patch level is current
host_patch_level_current.description: Host kernel and privileged OS packages at/above vendor-fixed builds with no pending security updates (e.g. sudo >=1.9.5p2 for CVE-2021-3156, >=1.9.12p2 for CVE-2023-22809). true=secure; exposure fires on is_false. Cross-platform (Linux + Windows).

host_kernel_eol.title: Host OS/kernel is past end-of-life
host_kernel_eol.description: Host runs an OS release/kernel series past vendor end-of-life (no more security fixes). true=EOL=insecure; exposure fires on is_true (distinct from a current-but-lagging host — an EOL base can never be patched current). Cross-platform.

sudo_least_privilege_configured.title: Sudo least-privilege and LPE-patched
sudo_least_privilege_configured.description: Sudo elevation is least-privilege (no blanket NOPASSWD ALL=(ALL) ALL, no exploitable wildcards) AND patched (>=1.9.5p2 CVE-2021-3156, >=1.9.12p2 CVE-2023-22809). true=secure; fires on is_false. Applies to Unix-like hosts (linux/macos/bsd) — gated to those families.

setuid_binaries_minimized_and_protected.title: Setuid/setgid inventory minimal and non-writable
setuid_binaries_minimized_and_protected.description: Host setuid/setgid set is minimal/known-good: only expected vendor binaries, root-owned, none group/world-writable, no setuid interpreters. true=secure; fires on is_false. Applies to Unix-like hosts (linux/macos/bsd).

windows_privilege_boundary_enforced.title: Windows SYSTEM/Admin privilege boundary enforced
windows_privilege_boundary_enforced.description: UAC enabled (EnableLUA=1, prompting ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin) and no unquoted service paths / weak service-binary ACLs that let a standard user overwrite a SYSTEM-run binary. true=secure; fires on is_false. Windows-only — gated to the windows family.

unprivileged_user_namespaces_restricted.title: Unprivileged user-namespace creation restricted
unprivileged_user_namespaces_restricted.description: Unprivileged unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER) restricted (kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0 Debian/Ubuntu, and/or user.max_user_namespaces bounded, and/or AppArmor userns restriction Ubuntu 23.10+). true=secure; fires on is_false. Linux-only kernel feature — gated to the linux family. Structural enabler: unrestricted userns expands reachable kernel surface ~3.4x and is a prerequisite for many netfilter/overlayfs LPE CVEs and container escapes landing as host root.

mandatory_access_control_enforcing.title: Host MAC (SELinux/AppArmor) loaded and enforcing
mandatory_access_control_enforcing.description: Kernel MAC (SELinux Enforcing, or AppArmor loaded with profiles in enforce mode) confines processes beyond DAC. true=secure; fires on is_false. Linux-only (SELinux/AppArmor) — gated to the linux family. Enforcing MAC blocks several container-escape/privesc primitives (e.g. the cgroupfs mount of CVE-2022-0492).

host_credential_files_access_restricted.title: On-host credential files restricted to root/owner
host_credential_files_access_restricted.description: On-host credential stores unreadable by unprivileged processes: the shadow store root-only (Linux /etc/shadow 0640 root:shadow; BSD /etc/master.passwd; macOS Directory Services) and SSH private keys 0600 owner-only, ~/.ssh 0700. true=secure; fires on is_false. Applies to Unix-like hosts (linux/macos/bsd).

windows_lsass_credential_protection_enab.title: Windows LSASS credential material protected from dumping
windows_lsass_credential_protection_enab.description: LSA Protection (RunAsPPL=1) enabled and, where VBS-supported, Credential Guard running — LSASS not dumpable for reusable hashes/tickets. true=secure; fires on is_false. Windows-only — gated to the windows family.

instance_metadata_service_hardened.title: Instance metadata service hardened (IMDSv2 enforced)
instance_metadata_service_hardened.description: Cloud host IMDS (169.254.169.254) cannot surrender IAM creds to an unauthenticated GET: session tokens mandatory (AWS HttpTokens=required) and PUT hop limit 1; or N/A-secure where the host runs no cloud metadata service. true=secure; fires on is_false. Cross-platform (cloud, OS-agnostic).

remote_admin_access_hardened.title: Remote administrative access hardened
remote_admin_access_hardened.description: Host management plane (SSH/RDP/WinRM) hardened: SSH key-only with root login disabled, RDP requires NLA, all admin surfaces (22/3389/5985-5986) reachable only via bastion/VPN/ZTNA or admin source-IP allowlist (not the open internet). true=secure; fires on is_false. Cross-platform (the assessor attests whichever of SSH/RDP/WinRM the host exposes).

boot_chain_integrity_protected.title: Boot chain integrity protected (Secure/measured boot + signed modules)
boot_chain_integrity_protected.description: Host boot chain integrity-protected below the OS: UEFI Secure Boot enabled (only vendor/enrolled keys), unsigned/tampered kernel modules and bootkits cannot load; TPM measured boot where supported. true=secure; fires on is_false. Cross-platform (Secure Boot on Linux + Windows).

host_integrity_monitoring_and_audit_enab.title: Host file-integrity monitoring and tamper audit enabled
host_integrity_monitoring_and_audit_enab.description: Host can detect+record tamper of system binaries/modules/boot files: file-integrity baseline active (AIDE) AND host audit logging/EDR running (auditd / Windows Event Log + Sysmon). true=secure; fires on is_false. Cross-platform (auditd/AIDE on Unix, Event Log/Sysmon on Windows). Scoped to the host's own integrity/tamper-evidence, not downstream SIEM/log-retention.

host_disk_encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Host volume at-rest disk encryption enabled
host_disk_encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Every data-bearing host volume encrypted at rest (LUKS on Linux, BitLocker Protection On on Windows, FileVault on macOS) so physical theft/detached disk/cloud snapshot yields only ciphertext. true=secure; fires on is_false. Cross-platform. Scoped to the machine's own disks, not app-level field encryption.
